text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High rate of 401/403 from edge-proxy cluster eu-west-1 — anomalous heartbeat pattern detected, suspected token replay. Samples: 3k reqs/min. Pager auto-joined: #incidents.

alice_ops: seeing same. spike started ~10m ago from a handful of IP ranges.

ben_oncall: I'm on it, shifting time. pulling recent reqs from kinesis now.

carla_security: tagging — could be credential scraping or a misconfigured forwarder. any customer errors?

eleine_support: 2 customers reported elevated 401s on dedicated deployments, but they said intermittent only. no outage reported yet.

ben_oncall: query results: some requests include repeated Authorization headers with different user-agents; lot of short-lived sessions. logs show repeated prefix of KV-cache-key in path fragments.

alice_ops: that's suspicious. may be telemetry replaying headers. can someone grep for S3 or external log-forwarder uploads?

dave_sre: running quick grep on logshipper: `aws s3api list-objects --bucket obs-uploads --prefix=eu-west/` — nothing new in last 2h.

carla_security: request sample log snippet pasted by ben showed verbose debug lines that include partial tokens. we need to treat as potential exfil. recommend rotate svcacct tokens for proxy forwarders and create immediate deny-list on observed IPs.

ben_oncall: creating deny rules on edge-nginx for top 10 offending IPs now. applying rate-limit 100/min per IP as temp mitigation. :lock:

incident-bot: ben_oncall added channel topic: "mitigation in progress — rate-limit + IP blocks"

elaine_support: starting customer sync. I've opened a quick brigade with the two customers to check if they saw extra debug logs or forwarded payloads.

frank_legal: please tag if any PII or customer tokens exposed. we may need to start notification timeline.

carla_security: initial assessment: 1) pattern looks like an automated scanner grabbing recent debug log bundles from staging-friendly buckets. 2) there are token-like fragments in a few debug lines — treat as credential exposure pending verification.

ben_oncall: pushed IP blocks and tightened rate limits. CPU load on proxy unchanged. KV cache miss rate increased ~30% due to repeated lookup keys.

alice_ops: runbook step 1: identify forwarders with recent config changes. runbook step 2: rotate implicated service tokens. runbook step 3: escalate to infra owners.

dave_sre: aligning infra owners now. Can we snapshot the list of service accounts that accessed the log-forwarder in last 24h? running `SELECT distinct(service_account) FROM wingbeat.access WHERE resource='log-forwarder' AND ts > now() - interval '24 hours';`

ben_oncall: results look like: `svc-logshipper-1`, `svc-proxy-eu`, `svc-ci-deployer`. I recommend rotating `svc-logshipper-1` and `svc-proxy-eu` first — highest activity.

carla_security: agreed. also lock down log-forwarder ingest to explicit source IPs for now and disable verbose debug logging.

elaine_support: customer update: both customers confirm they saw some 401 flurries but no clear data exfil. they're asking for ETA and impact details.

ben_oncall: ETA for token rotation ~15m for `svc-logshipper-1` (can hot-swap), ~30m for `svc-proxy-eu` (requires rolling restart). will coordinate with Dedicated ops.

carla_security: assign severity: P2 for now because tokens maybe exposed and there's targeted traffic but limited scope. start preserving logs for forensics (retain full headers).

incident-bot: created incident record INC-2026-0456 (severity P2) — responders: ben_oncall, carla_security, dave_sre.

dave_sre: starting rotation for `svc-logshipper-1`. command: `kms rotate-key --key-id alias/svc-logshipper-1 && update-secret --name svc-logshipper-1 --secret $(generate)` — will stage and test before swap.

ben_oncall: I'll coordinate rolling restart for `svc-proxy-eu` with on-call infra. scheduling as low-latency window to reduce client impact.

alice_ops: adding cleanup: search for any S3 objects created with suspicious user-agent `curl/0.1-scan` and quarantine if found. also snapshot audit DB for later correlation.

frank_legal: if rotation confirms token compromise, we should draft customer notif copy and timeline. keep me in loop.

carla_security: found one suspicious s3 object: `eu-west/2026-03-18/debug-2026-03-18-12.log.gz` uploaded 12:02 UTC, contains repeated lines with header fragments. Marking for quarantine and extraction.

ben_oncall: pulled and quarantined file to secure bucket. extracting indicators now.

dave_sre: `svc-logshipper-1` rotation complete and tested — new key in place, ingestion verified. no immediate errors.

ben_oncall: `svc-proxy-eu` rolling restart in progress — 20% of nodes restarted so far. monitoring for client errors.

elaine_support: telling customers: "We've implemented mitigations (IP blocks, rate limits) and rotated implicated service tokens; investigating potential log artifact exposure. We'll follow up with details in the next update."

carla_security: forensic note: extracting token fragments from quarantined log; will attempt to match full tokens in access logs to scope exposure. preserve all artifacts.

dave_sre: `svc-proxy-eu` restart finished. health checks green. error rate briefly spiked to 0.8% during restarts, back to baseline now.

ben_oncall: denial and rotation closed top-of-tree attack vectors. observed request rate dropped ~95%.

carla_security: preliminary scope: single quarantined log file contained partial token strings — we matched two token IDs to `svc-logshipper-1` prior-key material. rotation should invalidate them.

frank_legal: recommend we prepare a precautionary notification to the two affected customers with an offer to rotate any customer-side ingest keys and a short incident timeline.

elaine_support: drafting message. will attach interim timeline and mitigation summary, awaiting confirmation from carla_security on exact artifacts.

carla_security: confirming: no customer PII seen in the extracted artifacts. exposure limited to truncated auth fragments. still treat as potential credential leakage.

ben_oncall: will keep channel open for 1h to watch for rebound. if nothing else, we'll move to post-incident review and action items. :white_check_mark:

alice_ops: action items created: 1) enforce debug log gating behind env var and RBAC (owner: eng-logging). 2) tighten S3 bucket ACLs and lifecycle (owner: infra-storage). 3) improve detection for repeated short-lived auth patterns (owner: eng-observability). 4) update runbook for log-forwarder compromise (owner: carla_security).

incident-bot: incident INC-2026-0456 updated: mitigations applied, rotating->complete, monitoring.

ben_oncall: thanks team. leaving notes for postmortem. I'll hand to carla for incident write-up.

carla_security: I'll own the postmortem and customer comms follow-through. tagging legal and support. closing live-mitigation phase.

frank_legal: please include timeline and customer-facing phrasing; I'll review.

elaine_support: will send interim customer message now and follow with detailed notice after postmortem.

ben_oncall: oncall cleared. nice work everyone.

carla_security: closing thread for live mitigation. Postmortem target due in 72h.

incident-bot: incident INC-2026-0456 status -> monitoring."
